name: Beskar spear
description: A beskar spear was wielded by the Magistrate Morgan Elsbeth on Corvus during the New Republic Era. The staff was made of pure beskar, a metal alloy tied with Mandalorian culture.

data.name: Beskar spear
data.destroyed: c. 9 ABY, Glavis Ringworld (reforged into Grogu's chainmail shirt)
